author: jchucky81
quote:
I was so insanely excited to finally play GTA VI. I went in completely blind, fired up the game, and watched an awesome cutscene. Then the prologue started, and I immediately noticed the framerate was terrible, so i went into the menu to set it to Performance Mode. Only to receive a massive slap in the face and a gut punch while lying down. To find out the BIGGEST GAME OF THE YEAR BY FAAAR, in the year 2026 DOSENT SUPPORT performance mode!!! I am playing on a PS5 Pro, with one of the best TVs on the market, last year’s LG G5. Even on a base PS5, this would be unacceptable.  What the … is going on??? 
The game forces ray tracing, which locks it to 30fps, yet almost every other modern game includes a non ray-traced mode that runs at 60fps. WHAT WHERE THEY THINKING??? And people are blaming PlayStation and Xbox for outdated hardware and weak CPUs. Yes, the PS5 and Xbox Series X are aging, and even the PS5 Pro is held back by its CPU, but Rockstar chose to develop this game for current-gen consoles. They must have known the hardware limitations on this consoles. The PS6 hasn't even been announced yet. It's probably still 2 or 3 years away, and a PC release date still hasn't been confirmed. Where is the logic here?  who cares how good this game will run on playstation 8. Everybody knows this game is going to last for 15-20 years, but I didn't buy a version meant to be enjoyed five years down the line. 

When Gta v and Red dead redemption 2 came out 30 fps was the standard, games did not support 60 fps back then at least on consoles. These games was freaking awesome and a solid 10/10 masterpieces, but if they had released as brand new games now in 26 with only 30 fps i would have given it a 0 star. And that's because games capped that low, is simply unplayable for this type of game in 2026. Any modern 3D game locked at 30fps is a hard pass for me. When you are used to only play open world games at a minimum of 60fps. Since the PS4 Pro and Xbox One X introduced performance modes back in November 2017. Some of us have been gaming whit high frame rate for almost nine years, and the biggest game of all time is dragging us back to 2017, because they wanted ray tracing instead. 
Rockstar is one of the biggest, richest, and most talented developer in the world. They’ve never made a bad game, only masterpieces, and I have no doubt this game would be an absolute blast at 60fps. Why Rockstar games made this decision is completely mind baffling!

How critics and other players don't care about the framerate is beyond me. Yes it's an absolute stunningly beautiful game with amazing detail when standing still and admire the scenery. But that illusion shatter the second you start to move the camera. In a fast paced game, the stuttering, choppy screen every time you touch the analog stick ruins everything. What is the point of better graphics in a game where constant movement is the whole point? Walking slowly or driving in a straight line makes up maybe 0.07% of gameplay, and standing still in menus or admiring the view is maybe 0.8%. Why sacrifice performance and smoothness, which affects 99% of the experience, just to make the game look prettier for 1% of the time. Imagine how "razor sharp" the image would be at 15 fps. Would people had accepted that too. Are my eyes that different from most people's? like the soap opera effect which most people don’t notice, but is the first thing I turn off on a new TV. I wear glasses, but my vision is only slightly impaired with a tiny bit of astigmatism. Is it just a few off us that even notice how bad 30fps looks?
Do most people play all games in fidelity mode? and rarely use performance mode? I'm sure they'll love this game. And if i was back in 2017 i would have loved it too. But coming from 60 makes 30fps unplayable for me. 60fps should be the bare minimum for any AAA game. 

Rockstar confirmed the game will not receive a performance mode on modern consoles, even on the beefier PlayStation 5 Pro. It's possible they technically could ​​​​​​release a performance mode on console. BUT THEY SIMPLY DON'T THINK THE VISUAL TRADE OFF IS WORTH IT!!! And that they won't budge, is what they have stated. All because of ray-tracing, which is actually possible to fix. But sound like something Rockstar is hesitant to allow.   WHAT???  Even my 66 year old father took one look at the screen and said it looked choppy. I would even sacrifice graphics dropping down to PS3 visuals just to avoid 30 fps. That is how much i despise low frame rates! I can count on one hand, maybe two hands, games which did not support performance mode, and i have played hundreds of games, but they all has received a patch that supports Performance Mode, with the exception of maybe a couple from 4 years back. My whole day has been spent writing this review, time that should have been spent playing GTA 6. this is 2026! I feel betrayed! Until the developers add a Performance Mode, my score stays at a 0. An absolute disaster.
